This method will fail to accurately count the images embedded in the article, as images are typically found in the main content flow or specific infoboxes, not necessarily listed as rows in a table with the keyword "image". Furthermore, the specific function `scrape_wikipedia_tables` is unlikely to return a flat list of rows containing image metadata in the way the code assumes. The correct approach would be to use a web scraping tool to parse the HTML of the main article body and count the `` tags or image thumbnails, rather than relying on table data.
